newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivian president reaffirms will sign trade pact.
newsitem.headline: Bolivian president reaffirms will sign trade pact.

text.p: Bolivian President Gonzalo Sanchez de Lozada Thursday dismissed calls from a major business group to postpone the signing of a free trade agreement with the Mercosur customs union.
"It would be a great error not to move close to Mercosur," Sanchez de Lozada told reporters, reaffirming that he will sign the agreement in the Brazilian city of Fortaleza next week.
Bolivia's Business Confederation Called Wednesday for the signing to be postponed at least until next March.
Mercosur is a customs union grouping South America's two largest nations, Brazil and Argentina, with Uruguay and Paraguay. Chile earlier this year signed a free-trade agreement with the block.
